    Overview & Authentication¶

    Create Token¶

    POST Auth_Base_URL/api/v1/create-token

    This API is used to create jwt tokens.

    Header¶

    Client-Secret:API KEY
Vendor : VENDOR_NAME

    Payload¶

    {
  "scope": "vendors_scope",
  "grant_type": "client_credentials"
}

    Response¶

    status:200¶

    {
  "type": "Bearer",
  "token": "74a3bbcfca92f5e11289bb9876453b3c2fbc43ce7e8129c72e03a8cf57b28da6",
  "expires_at": 3599
}

    Status 401 , 400

    {
  "message": "The given data was invalid."
}

    Get Days¶

    GET Base_URL/api/v1/vendor/days

    This API is used to retrieve the available days and their IDs.

    Payload¶

    This endpoint does not require a request payload.

    Response¶

    [
{
"id": 1,
"name": "الأثنين",
"name_en": "Monday",
"code": "Mon"
